description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{R}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Dormant Volcano.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Dormant Volcano.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Locus of Enlightenment
